title: May a good-faith estimate be deducted for this repair or cleaning in place of final documents, and what must follow?

source.quote: If a repair to be done by the landlord or the landlord’s employee cannot reasonably be completed within 21 calendar days after the tenant has vacated the premises
Within 14 calendar days of completing the repair or receiving the documentation, the landlord shall complete the requirements in paragraphs (1) and (2) in the manner specified.

children.statement: The amount deducted is a good-faith estimate of the charges that will be incurred.

question.wording: Is the estimated amount a good-faith figure for the charges that will actually be incurred, grounded in a written quote, the agreed scope, or the company rate schedule, rather than a padded or unsupported number?

source.quote: the landlord may deduct the amount of a good faith estimate of the charges that will be incurred and provide that estimate with the itemized statement.
